items.question: Can I really put this on as many TVs as I want?
items.answer: Yes. Every plan includes unlimited screens. One office or twenty — same price.

items.question: What counts as a "tracked member"?
items.answer: Anyone who shows up on leaderboards, celebrations, or team photos. Admins who only configure the system don't count toward your limit.

items.question: Do you offer annual billing?
items.answer: Yes — save 20% when you pay annually. You can switch between monthly and annual at any time.

items.question: What if we outgrow our plan?
items.answer: Upgrade anytime, instantly. No migration, no downtime. Your celebrations don't skip a beat.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes — 14 days, full access, no credit card required. If you're not celebrating by day 3, we'll personally help you set up.

items.question: What hardware do I need?
items.answer: Any screen with a web browser. Smart TV, Chromecast, Fire Stick, old laptop connected to a monitor — whatever you've got. No app to install.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Month-to-month, no contracts, no cancellation fees. We'd rather earn your business every month than lock you in.

items.question: Do you support custom integrations?
items.answer: Our generic webhook connector works with any system that can send JSON. For deeper custom integrations, talk to us on the Enterprise plan.

story.title: How it started
paragraphs: CelebBoard started as an internal project. We built a TV dashboard for our own office — a screen that showed live metrics, celebrated closed deals, and put team members' faces on screen when they hit milestones.

The effect was immediate. People stopped what they were doing when confetti hit the screen. Reps who'd been quiet about their wins got a standing ovation from the whole office. The numbers on the leaderboard became a conversation starter, not a pressure tool.

We realized this wasn't just a nice-to-have. It was a missing piece of office culture — the visual, shared, joyful recognition of work well done. So we turned it into a product that any activity-driven team can set up in minutes.
Today, CelebBoard is the celebration engine for teams that track individual performance — in sales, production, advisory, and beyond. If there's a number and a person behind it, we make it a moment.
